title: Patient Payment Plans Credit Policy: Plan-Standing Share of Add-On Charges
content:
An add-on charge on an active Patient Payment Plans plan carries a plan-standing share that reflects how the plan has been paid and the late-fee record of the patient's Patient Financial Account.

**Policy.** The plan-standing share of the add-on is:

- 0.97 when the plan shows at least 6 installments paid and no missed installment, every installment paid on it was paid by automatic debit, and the financial account shows no late fee posted less than 12 whole months before the enrollment date;
- 0.985 when the plan shows at least 6 installments paid and no missed installment, at least one installment paid on it was paid other than by automatic debit, and the account shows no such late fee;
- 1 in every other case.

The share multiplies the counted amount of the add-on, without intermediate rounding.

**Records read.** On the plan: the installments paid, whether each was paid by automatic debit, and any missed installment. On the Patient Financial Account: late fees by posting date.

| Installments paid on the plan | Missed installment on the plan | All paid installments by automatic debit | Late fee less than 12 whole months before enrollment | Share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6 or more | None | Yes | None | 0.97 |
| 6 or more | None | No (at least one paid otherwise) | None | 0.985 |
| 6 or more | One or more | Either | Either | 1 |
| 6 or more | None | Either | One or more | 1 |
| Fewer than 6 | Either | Either | Either | 1 |

**Examples (hypothetical).**

- Seven installments paid, all by automatic debit, none missed, no recent late fee; counted amount 550.00: 550.00 multiplied by 0.97 is 533.50.
- Six installments paid, one of them by check, none missed, no recent late fee: 0.985.
- Five installments paid, all by automatic debit: fewer than 6, so 1.
